label: iii
title: If you are new to statistics

blocks.html:
• You need only school mathematics: fractions, percentages, powers, square roots and logarithms. Anything beyond that is explained where it first appears, or marked as beyond this book.
  • On a first reading, read the Definition, Simplified Explanation, Illustration and Must-Know Notes of each section, and do the Checkpoints. The Derivation boxes can be skimmed and revisited once the idea feels familiar.
  • Keep a calculator beside you. Every worked calculation can be followed with pen, paper and a calculator.
  • Use the list of symbols below whenever a sign or letter looks unfamiliar. Each symbol is also explained in the text where it is first used.
